svg.title: amp Search view empty states comparison
svg.desc: Two side-by-side mockups of amp's blank Search view. The left mockup shows a first-open state with no recent searches: chrome with active Bluetooth button, a prominent search input field showing a magnifying glass icon and the placeholder text Search library, a centered hint consisting of a muted magnifying glass icon and the text Search your library with a smaller subtitle artists, albums, or songs, and the bottom tab bar with Search selected as a dark-navy inversion. The right mockup shows the same view but with a populated recent searches list: the search input at top, then a yellow brutalist header block reading Recent, then four recent search query rows showing Radiohead, Ambient, Kid A, and Sufjan Stevens, each with a small close X on the right for deletion, followed by a muted Clear recent text link, and the same bottom tab bar.
